summary: VistaOne, L.P. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose the Transactional Net Asset Value (NAV) per unit for each class of the fund as of May 31, 2026. This is a routine periodic NAV calculation for subscription and repurchase pricing, not an event-driven special situation. No merger, acquisition, tender, activist campaign, or structural change is involved. The filing is administrative and informational, with no deal terms or strategic actions disclosed.
